legend: Sergei Rachmaninoff is hosting a competition — which if his students can best play his latest composition - Opus 18 Piano Concerto No. 2. He has n$$$n$$$ students, numbered 1,2,...n$$$1, 2, ... n$$$, each of which is also part of various circles in the Russian mafia. The students all have a rival who they want to target — student i$$$i$$$ wants to shoot down student si$$$s_i$$$. Note that it is possible for i=si$$$i = s_i$$$ (the nerves ... ).

You, Rachmaninoff's assistant, want to minimize the bloodshed. Therefore, you want to order the students in such a way so as to minimize the bloodshed — you don't like violence. The students play sequentially, and if its a student's turn but they are already dead, the competition moves on to the next in line. Each students best opportunity to shoot their assigned rival is as they are exiting the stage, therefore, student i$$$i$$$ only attempts to shoot si$$$s_i$$$ once they have finished performing, before the next performance starts. Find the minimum number of casualties across all possible permutations of students at this event.
input: The first line of input contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤200,000$$$1 \le n \le 200,000$$$) — the number of students.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ space separated integers s1,s2,...sn$$$s_1, s_2, ... s_n$$$ (1≤si≤n$$$1 \le s_i \le n$$$) — the student who the i$$$i$$$th student wants to shoot down, respectively.
output: A single integer that gives the minimum number of casualties in the competition across all permutations of students.
note: In the first sample, we can achieve 3 deaths (and no better) from the order of performances - 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8.
In the second sample, everyone is able to target themself, so .
The third sample is a cycle - the order 1 2 3 4 5 6 ensures only 3 deaths.
In the fourth sample, the order 5 1 2 3 4 targets 3 people, with students 3 and 5 surviving at the end.

legend.ai: 谢尔盖·拉赫玛尼诺夫正在举办一场比赛，看看他的学生中谁能最好地演奏他最新创作的作品——《第2号钢琴协奏曲》(作品18)。他有 n$$$n$$$ 名学生，编号为 1,2,...n$$$1, 2, ... n$$$，每个人也都属于俄罗斯黑手党的不同帮派圈子。所有学生都有一个想要除掉的对手——学生 i$$$i$$$ 想要击毙学生 si$$$s_i$$$。注意，可能出现 i=si$$$i = s_i$$$ 的情况(紧张过度……)。
作为拉赫玛尼诺夫的助手，你想尽量减少流血事件。因此，你希望安排学生的顺序，使流血事件尽可能少——你不喜欢暴力。学生们依次表演，如果轮到某名学生时他已经死了，比赛就继续进行下一位。每名学生击毙指定对手的最佳时机是在离开舞台时，因此，学生 i$$$i$$$ 只有在完成表演后、下一场表演开始前，才会尝试射击 si$$$s_i$$$。求这场活动中所有可能的学生排列下的最少伤亡人数。

input.ai: 第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数 s1,s2,...sn$$$s_1, s_2, ... s_n$$$(1≤si≤n$$$1 \le s_i \le n$$$)——分别表示第 i$$$i$$$ 名学生想要击倒的学生。

output.ai: 一个整数，表示在所有学生排列中，比赛中的最少伤亡人数。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，按照表演顺序 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8，可以实现 3 人死亡（且无法做到更好）。
在第二个样例中，每个人都能瞄准自己，所以 。
第三个样例是一个环——顺序 1 2 3 4 5 6 可以确保只有 3 人死亡。
在第四个样例中，顺序 5 1 2 3 4 会针对 3 个人，最终学生 3 和 5 存活下来。
